item.title: Crash on U.S. 65 Monday morning leaves one hospitalized
item.description: A person was seriously injured while attempting to remove debris from U.S. 65 north of Springfield when struck by a vehicle, and an investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Snow wreaks havoc on Springfield metro traffic
